name: ESTATE AI
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm ci

postAttachCommand.api: if [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then export CORS_ORIGINS="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-5173.app.github.dev"; fi; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8088
postAttachCommand.frontend: if [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then export VITE_API_URL="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-8088.app.github.dev"; fi; cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
